description: This file is a bash script used to download kernel information files, including kernel images and metadata, from specified URLs based on build IDs extracted from local files. It contains functions to fetch individual files and loop over directories to batch download related kernel data.

methods.name: download_kernel_info_files
methods.description: Downloads specific kernel info files from a remote server if they are listed in the provided JSON list, saving them into a specified output folder.

methods.name: download_all_kernel_info_files
methods.description: Iterates over directories matching a pattern to extract build IDs and invokes 'download_kernel_info_files' for each.
